title: Civilian Rescue: Detect, Shield, Escort, Debris Lift
description:
Purpose: End-to-end civilian rescue loop: detect civilians, apply Shield Bubble, create stepping paths, lift debris with Grabber Hand, and escort to evac points with scoring bonuses.

Controls:
- A Button: Interact / confirm / context action when near civilians or evac beacons.
- Utility constructs (bubble, grabber) as per utility_constructs.

Behaviour:
1) Civilian detection: tag civilians (civilian_npc_pack) and register to rescue system; spawn evac markers.
2) Shield bubble application: attach short-duration protective field that soaks damage; health displayed on HUD.
3) Debris lift: detect heavy debris; prompt to use Grabber Hand; validate clear path.
4) Escort: set civilian follow; avoid hazards; arrival at evac triggers score event and VO bark.

Components:
- Reads: proximity triggers, hazard volumes.
- Writes: CCivilianState, escort paths, CHUD markers, score events.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_civilian_bubble_escort.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on mission_system (objective updates) and utility_constructs (bubble/grabber features).

Scenes:
- civilian_rescue_zone, alien_city_attack.

Suggested file split: rescue_register.cpp, rescue_runtime.cpp, rescue_ui.cpp.
